# Gan.AI

Gan.AI provides advanced APIs for text-to-speech, voice cloning, and video personalization, enabling developers to integrate natural and expressive speech synthesis into their applications.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/gan-ai/.

## Actions

- **GAN AI Text-to-Speech**: Convert text to speech synchronously.
- **GAN.AI Login**: Authenticate a user and retrieve tokens.
- **Get Avatar Video Inference Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed status and metadata for a specific avatar video inference.
- **Get Photo Avatar Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information for a specific photo avatar by ID.
- **Get photo avatar inference details** (read-only): Fetch photo avatar inference details.
- **List avatar video inferences** (read-only): List avatar video inferences.
- **List photo avatar inferences** (read-only): List photo avatar inferences.
- **List Photo Avatars** (read-only): List avatars.
- **Login**: Authenticate a user and retrieve access and refresh tokens.
